memoryRule: a pressure path changes only a resistance ledger; release selects three remote material roles so one stratum hardens, one fractures, and one binds; later casts inherit the ledger
interactionRule: pointer drag or Arrow keys load a geometry-neutral probe; pointer release, Enter, Space, or the cast control commits; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: CSS attention orbit, Canvas forecast loom, and SVG reciprocal body -> Canvas 2D raster specimen of irregular strata and produced fault geometry
compositionRupture: radial vacancy, staggered ribs, and split body -> vertical cast with offset plates, internal fault, and remote material roles
encounterRupture: audit absence, offer a signal, and enter-and-withdraw -> drag pressure through a specimen, then release the load into a new production rule
temporalRupture: attention debt and forecast comparison -> material memory where stored resistance changes the next geometry
mediumRupture: semantic CSS polygon, p5.js Canvas loom, and inline SVG -> deterministic Canvas 2D polygonal raster with no DOM geometry or SVG renderer
changedRule: A pressure path is geometry-neutral while it loads a resistance ledger. Release makes accumulated resistance produce three remote roles: harden, fracture, and bind; the contact point is only a probe.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a nine-stratum Canvas 2D cast. A drag keeps the specimen exact; release changes actual remote width/depth, notch/split, and bridge geometry. Four casts persist and alter later role selection.
falsifier: Delete if the probe draws itself, if the contact point is the answer, if harden/fracture/bind are cosmetic, if later casts reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v036 if caption-free viewing reads as a generic bar chart, decorative stack, or brush simulation rather than a material self-portrait.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
